content: Words are like eggs: once dropped from the nest, they cannot be gathered back.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: A fragile egg held in the palm requires exquisite gentleness; one careless drop onto stone shatters the shell and spills the yolk forever. You cannot un-say an insult, a cruel rumor, or a spiteful label. Treat speech with the reverence of holding living eggs.
practicalInsight: Before you speak sharply in frustration today, picture holding a fragile egg. Speak only with protective care.
reflectionPrompt: What words did you recklessly drop in the past that you wish you could gather back into your hands?
